description: Retrieve the existing feedback already saved for a specific user or group in a dropbox folder, for an instructor or TA — score, graded state, feedback text, and rubric assessment detail. Use this before drafting new feedback to see what has already been recorded. Requires instructor or TA access to the course.

courseId.description: Course ID the dropbox folder belongs to.

entityId.description: User ID or group ID whose existing feedback to retrieve.

entityType.description: Whether entityId identifies an individual user or a group.

name: get_dropbox_feedback
title: Get Dropbox Feedback
